pages.text: All of these need an $(item)Industrial Mixer with a Mixer Blade$() and accept $(item)every vat kind$(), size 1 and up.

$(l)Liquid Concrete$()$(br)1 Sand, 1 Gravel, 1 Limesand, 250 mB Water give $(item)32000 mB$() Liquid Concrete. That fills all four output tanks of a 1x1 vat at default size, so empty it after each batch or use a bigger vat.

$(l)Liquid Asphalt$()$(br)1 Asphalt Mixture and 250 mB Water give 1000 mB Liquid Asphalt in 5 seconds.$(br2)$(l)Sulfuric Acid$()$(br)3 Sulfur Dust, 1 Nitrate Dust and 1000 mB Water give 500 mB Sulfuric Acid.

$(l)Rubber$()$(br)1 Sulfur Dust and 250 mB Heavy Oil give 1 Rubber Sheet. Needs $(item)heat 2$().$(br2)$(l)Naphtha cracking$()$(br)500 mB Naphtha gives 250 mB Ethylene and 250 mB Propylene. Needs $(item)heat 2$().
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
